lanes.summary: Oura sends many notification types (bedtime, insights, inactivity) and shows a workout Live Activity, but where a tap lands, and what happens when signed out, is neither observed nor documented.

The app keeps working and explains missing data ("Where's my route?" names Location Services "Always on"), but it offers only "Got it", not a Settings link; for notifications the help center gives the manual iOS Settings path.
steps: "Check Bluetooth is enabled on your phone"

lanes.summary: Membership is not sold through StoreKit: setup opens a web checkout (signup.ouraring.com: free month, card or PayPal, billing address), then "Membership complete"; cancel and payment-failure screens were not observed.

lanes.summary: Downgrade is gentle and keeps data (three daily scores, battery, profile, settings and Explore stay; data stays saved and exportable as CSV; re-enrolling restores access), but no grace-period or failed-payment messaging was documented.
steps: Access kept to end of billing period
CSV in Membership Hub; data kept

lanes.summary: Account-based: sign in (password or emailed code), pick and connect the ring, run "Sync data", and history returns; membership lives on the account, so there is no Restore Purchases to find.
steps: "We need to sync your data to continue"

lanes.summary: In-app Settings > "Delete account and all data", one alert that names what is lost (account, data and "any prepaid membership plans"), then the signed-out welcome; per the help center, deleting cancels the membership automatically.

The ring stores data and syncs to the app later, and cloud upload needs Wi-Fi or cellular; Advisor shows "Can't load chat" with Try again (cause unlabelled), but the phone-offline state of Today was not observed.
steps: Syncs to app when back in range

lanes.summary: Advisor is opt-in ("optional", collects nothing until setup) and withdrawal is in-app: Advisor > Settings > "Reset Advisor" erases memories and settings, and using it again re-runs setup; check-ins can be turned off. The only off switch is the full reset, so there is no pause that keeps history.

lanes.summary: Data lives in Oura's cloud and returns on a new phone after sign-in, but Oura's setup rule is "one ring, one account, one device"; Circles share only chosen scores (daily or weekly), joins need a single-use 7-day invite, and anyone can leave or be removed at any time, with a notice shown to the removed member.
steps: Log in, then remove old app
